job.question: Which retirement system's investment consultant RFP requires firms to certify that they currently provide investment consulting services to clients whose combined assets total at least $50 billion?
job.expected_facts: Teachers' Retirement System of the State of Illinois (TRS Illinois), in its FY23 investment consultant RFP (Appendix B, Statement of Minimum Qualifications).
job.acceptance: TRS Illinois / Teachers’ Retirement System of the State of Illinois is sufficient; FY23 and appendix identifier are optional.

reviews.reason: This is SFERS’ investment consultant RFP, not a TRS Illinois RFP. Its stated minimum qualification concerns a professional’s experience, and its desired client qualification does not require certification of consulting clients with combined assets of at least $50 billion.
quotes: Request for Proposals for General Investment Consulting Services for the City and County of San Francisco Employees’ Retirement System
A Proposer must meet the following minimum qualification to SFERS’ satisfaction:
At least one key professional member of the Firm proposed for the SFERS account must have a minimum of ten (10) years of experience working with institutional clients.
The Firm must currently provide investment consulting services to at least three clients of similar size and complexity to SFERS.
